question: tool_choice required vs any — whats the difference
supported_answer: They are two different vendors' names for forcing a tool call, not two settings in one API. In the OpenAI Agents SDK, tool_choice='required' makes the LLM use a tool while still letting it pick which one. In the Anthropic Messages API the equivalent is tool_choice type 'any' — the model will use any available tool. Anthropic has no 'required' value and OpenAI's Agents SDK has no 'any' value.

question: how do i turn off parallel tool calls
supported_answer: Set disable_parallel_tool_use to true on tool_choice. It defaults to false. Under tool_choice auto that yields at most one tool use; under any or tool it yields exactly one.

evidence.quote:
- `disable_parallel_tool_use: optional boolean`

      Whether to disable parallel tool use.

      Defaults to `false`. If set to `true`, the model will output at most one tool use.
